faqs.a:
(a)
An applicant for a permit to allow construction, excavation, or work in the public
               right-of-way under this section shall:
(1)
File a written application on forms furnished by the city that include the following:
               the date of application; the name and address of the applicant; the name and address
               of the developer, contractor, or subcontractor licensed to perform work in the public
               right-of-way; a traffic control plan; the exact location of the proposed construction,
               excavation, or work activity; the type of existing public infrastructure (street pavement,
               curb and gutter, sidewalks, or utilities) impacted by the construction, excavation,
               or work; the purpose of the proposed construction, excavation, or work; the dates
               for beginning and ending the proposed construction, excavation, or work; proposed
               hours of work; itemization of the total cost of restoration; itemization of total
               cost of public improvements; itemization of total cost and quantities of materials;
               and type of work proposed.
(2)
Include an accurate and truthful written statement that the applicant or its contractor
               is not delinquent in payments due the city on prior work.
(3)
Attach copies of all documentation required to do the proposed work and to work in
               the public rights-of-way.
(4)
Unless otherwise established by franchise agreement with the city, provide a satisfactory
               plan of work showing protection of the subject property and adjacent properties, including
               existing landscaping.
(5)
Include a signed statement verifying that all orders issued by the city to the applicant,
               requiring the applicant to correct deficiencies under previous permits issued under
               this article, have been satisfied. This verification shall not apply to outstanding
               claims that are honestly and reasonably disputed by the applicant, if the applicant
               and the city are negotiating in good faith to resolve the dispute.
(6)
Include with the application engineering construction drawings or site plans for the
               proposed construction, excavation, or work.
(7)
Include with the application a satisfactory traffic control and erosion protection
               plan for the proposed construction, excavation, or work.
(8)
Include a statement indicating any proposed joint use or ownership of the facility;
               any existing facility or permit of the applicant at this location; any existing facility
               of others with which the proposed installations might conflict; and the name, address,
               and telephone number of a representative of the applicant available to review proposed
               locations at the site.
(9)
Pay the fees prescribed by this article. Applicant may establish a cash escrow with
               the city from which permit fees may be paid.
(b)
Applicants shall update any new information on permit applications within ten days
               after any change occurs.
(c)
Applicants may apply jointly for permits to work in public rights-of-way at the same
               time and place. Applicants who apply jointly for permits may share in the payment
               of the permit fee. Applicants must agree among themselves as to the portion each shall
               pay.
(Code 1981, § 27-204; Ord. No. 3717, § 1, 8-27-2001; Ord. No.
4725
, § 2, 5-4-2020)
